result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue in the 'Fastest near you' carousel where one restaurant card is vertically misaligned.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card (including its image, title, and delivery fee text) is shifted downward and misaligned relative to the adjacent 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol...' cards.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all cards in the 'Fastest near you' row share consistent top alignment, image container dimensions, and vertical spacing so their tops and text baselines align.
